name: Canada

format.notes: Multiple choice or true/false, in English or French. Three chances to pass. The test does not assess language skills.

official_study_material.title: Discover Canada: The Rights and Responsibilities of Citizenship

unverified.format.modes: The study page gives the length and question types; the page on how the test is conducted (online or in person) could not be opened. "computer" is unconfirmed.
unverified.exemptions: The page saying who must take the test could not be opened. Widely reported as ages 18 to 54; not confirmed here.
unverified.fee: No separate test fee stated on the pages read.

notes: Discover Canada is the only official study guide. Reuse in a paid app is commercial, so it needs permission under the Canada.ca terms.
